---
title: "Current implementation and first use"
---

Offline mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, reminders, notes and feeds, with explicit account refresh. IMAP reading and manual Nextcloud sync are connected; sending, Microsoft 365 sign-in and background sync are unavailable in the production UI.

This page describes the October 2026 source revision. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

## Build from a clean checkout

Flutter 3.47.9 / Dart 3.13.7, Python 3, JDK 17, Android SDK 36 and build-tools 35.0.0. Set JAVA_HOME and ANDROID_HOME. A device/emulator is required to install; a full Xcode installation is needed for iOS.

```sh
flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
flutter analyze
flutter test
flutter build apk --debug --target-platform android-arm64
adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk
```

These commands build from this source tree. Debug APKs are development artifacts; release bundles need private signing and device acceptance. A successful build is not a store submission.

## Use and verification

Read the [repository README](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-courrier/blob/main/README.md) for the exact application workflow, privacy/storage behavior and platform differences. The [October refinement record](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-courrier/blob/main/docs/refinement-2026-10.md) records findings, changes, observed checks, deferred work and the next release action. Local checks alone do not establish remote CI results.

For published source `7ca7cef025ba`, [application CI](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-courrier/actions/runs/41200136886) passed on 2026-10-31, including Android packaging and full unsigned iOS compilation. Installed-device behavior, live-account acceptance and signed distribution remain separate gates.
